scope: UTM undergraduate library services (V1); out-of-scope records excluded from retrieval_records
authority_note: S02 UTM Library Handbook 2026/2027 governs the verified 2026/2027 tables. S09 and S16 webpages conflict with S02 for some loan limits and fines; the conflict is documented. Undergraduate yearly fees are stated as "Refer university fees rate" on S02 PDF page 18; no zero-fee amount is established.
rights_status: Source-text redistribution not yet verified; these records hold factual figures with attribution, not source prose. See docs/week4_rights_verification.md.
usage: Only retrieval_records are approved for undergraduate V1 answering. The future retriever must enforce scope, source applicability and authority_rank. All 373 K2 chunks remain blocked. Page locators use one-based PDF reader system page numbers. No deployed retriever exists yet.

S16.title: Fines
S16.role: official webpage (noted outdated for some fine rows)

retrieval_records.statement: An undergraduate (Degree) student may borrow 10 Open Access books for 2 weeks, renewable 2 times.
retrieval_records.verified: S02 UTM Library Handbook 2026/2027, PDF system page p25 (loan limits) and p18 (renewal eligibility); visually checked 2026-11-28.

retrieval_records.statement: An undergraduate may borrow 1 Closed Access item for 2 days.
retrieval_records.verified: S02 UTM Library Handbook 2026/2027, PDF system page p25; visually checked 2026-11-28.
retrieval_records.note: S09 webpage lists different figures (3 items/3 days); handbook governs by source precedence.

retrieval_records.statement: An undergraduate may borrow 1 Bound Journal for 3 days.
retrieval_records.verified: S02 UTM Library Handbook 2026/2027, PDF system page p25; visually checked 2026-11-28.
retrieval_records.note: S09 webpage lists different figures (3 items/3 days); handbook governs by source precedence.

retrieval_records.statement: An undergraduate may borrow 1 Current Journal overnight.
retrieval_records.verified: S02 UTM Library Handbook 2026/2027, PDF system page p25; visually checked 2026-11-28.
retrieval_records.note: S09 webpage lists different figures (3 items/3 days); handbook governs by source precedence.

retrieval_records.statement: An undergraduate may borrow 1 Reference Book for 3 days.
retrieval_records.verified: S02 UTM Library Handbook 2026/2027, PDF system page p25; visually checked 2026-11-28.
retrieval_records.note: S09 webpage lists different figures (3 items/3 days); handbook governs by source precedence.

retrieval_records.statement: An undergraduate may borrow 1 Audio Visual item for 2 hours or overnight.
retrieval_records.verified: S02 UTM Library Handbook 2026/2027, PDF system page p25; visually checked 2026-11-28.
retrieval_records.note: S09 webpage states not for loan; S02 PDF system page p25 lists 1 item for 2 hours / overnight. The handbook governs by source precedence.

retrieval_records.statement: The overdue fine for Open Access materials is RM0.20 per day.
retrieval_records.verified: S02 UTM Library Handbook 2026/2027, PDF system page p28; visually checked 2026-11-28.

retrieval_records.statement: The overdue fine for Closed Access materials is RM0.50 per day.
retrieval_records.verified: S02 UTM Library Handbook 2026/2027, PDF system page p28; visually checked 2026-11-28.

retrieval_records.statement: The overdue fine for Reference materials is RM0.50 per day.
retrieval_records.verified: S02 UTM Library Handbook 2026/2027, PDF system page p28; visually checked 2026-11-28.

retrieval_records.statement: The overdue fine for Bound Journals is RM0.50 per day.
retrieval_records.verified: S02 UTM Library Handbook 2026/2027, PDF system page p28; visually checked 2026-11-28.

retrieval_records.statement: The overdue fine for Current Journals is RM0.50 per day.
retrieval_records.verified: S02 UTM Library Handbook 2026/2027, PDF system page p28; visually checked 2026-11-28.

retrieval_records.statement: The overdue fine for Audio Visual Materials (external borrowing) is RM0.50 per day.
retrieval_records.verified: S02 UTM Library Handbook 2026/2027, PDF system page p28; visually checked 2026-11-28.

retrieval_records.statement: A fine of RM30.00 is imposed for a lost or damaged library room key.
retrieval_records.verified: S02 UTM Library Handbook 2026/2027, PDF system page p16; visually checked 2026-11-28.

retrieval_records.statement: A RM25.00 processing fee applies to every lost or damaged material replacement.
retrieval_records.verified: S02 UTM Library Handbook 2026/2027, PDF system page p28; visually checked 2026-11-28.

retrieval_records.statement: A lost or damaged book is charged the price of the book plus a RM25.00 processing fee (or same edition/latest plus RM25.00).
retrieval_records.verified: S02 UTM Library Handbook 2026/2027, PDF system page p28; visually checked 2026-11-28.

retrieval_records.statement: A lost UTM thesis is charged RM350 (First Degree), RM450 (Masters) or RM550 (PhD) plus RM25.00 processing fee.
retrieval_records.verified: S02 UTM Library Handbook 2026/2027, PDF system page p28; visually checked 2026-11-28.

retrieval_records.statement: A lost journal article is charged up to RM75.00 (maximum BLDSC charge) plus RM25.00 processing fee.
retrieval_records.verified: S02 UTM Library Handbook 2026/2027, PDF system page p28; visually checked 2026-11-28.

retrieval_records.statement: A lost measured drawing is charged RM500.00 plus RM25.00 processing fee.
retrieval_records.verified: S02 UTM Library Handbook 2026/2027, PDF system page p28; visually checked 2026-11-28.

retrieval_records.statement: A lost rare material is charged double the price of the material plus RM25.00 processing fee.
retrieval_records.verified: S02 UTM Library Handbook 2026/2027, PDF system page p28; visually checked 2026-11-28.

retrieval_records.statement: For registered full-time UTM Degree students, the handbook lists yearly fees as "Refer university fees rate"; it does not specify a separate library registration amount or a zero annual fee.

value.separate_registration_amount: not specified on the cited handbook page

retrieval_records.verified: S02 UTM Library Handbook 2026/2027, PDF system page p18; visually checked 2026-11-28.
retrieval_records.note: Do not answer that UTM students pay no annual fee; refer the student to the current university fee schedule if an amount is requested.

out_of_scope_note: External, corporate, alumni, UTM Family and UTM SPACE membership charges are outside the undergraduate V1 scope; do not apply them to enrolled undergraduate students. The corporate-only membership-transfer fee is preserved in out_of_scope_records for audit, not in retrieval_records.

out_of_scope_records.applies_to: Corporate membership (within the country); outside undergraduate V1 scope
out_of_scope_records.statement: The services description for Corporate membership (within the country) lists a RM50.00 membership transfer fee.
out_of_scope_records.verified: S02 UTM Library Handbook 2026/2027, PDF system page p21; visually checked 2026-11-28.
out_of_scope_records.exclusion_reason: S02 PDF system page p21 lists this fee under Corporate membership (within the country). It is a corporate membership fee, not a general undergraduate transfer fee or a staff fee.
